learning_outcomes.text: Will be able to derive performance equations using energy and mass balances for different reactor types.
Will be able to solve reactor-related problems by analyzing experimental data in constant and variable volume systems.
Will be able to solve isothermal and non-isothermal reactor problems.
Will be able to solve problems related to multiple reactor systems.
Will be able to solve problems related to reactor systems using different methods through individual study.

syllabus_topics: Basic Concepts in Chemical Reactor Design
Design Principles of Homogeneous Reactors under Isothermal and Non-Isothermal Conditions
Ideal Batch, Plug Flow, and Mixed Reactors
bibliography: Levenspiel, O., “Chemical Reaction Engineering”, John Willey and Sons., 1962.
Levenspiel, O., “The Chemical Reactor Omnibook”, OSU Book Stores, 1989.
Smith, J.M., “Chemical Engineering Kinetics”, McGraw-Hill Book Co., 1981.
Fogler, H.S., “Elements of Chemical Reaction Engineering”, Prentice Hall International Editions, 1992.
